description: Use to press a button or field: by text/content-desc (text), resource-id (id), a point x,y, or index alone = the [n] line of the last screen outline (no new tree read while that window still has focus). Element match = exact first, then case-insensitive contains. 0 or several matches (text/id without index) fail and list the candidates; retry with index (0-based among the matches) or id. Returns the tapped point and the new screen outline once it settled (screen:false to skip), so no separate screen call is needed.

id.description: resource-id, full or the part after :id/

index.description: alone: [n] of the last screen; with text/id: 0-based among the matches

screen.description: false = do not return the new screen

name: tap
